facility.pipeline: NASA/JPL Photojournal PIA00405, enhanced color composite

columns.name: display level
columns.description: 0 to 255, the gray of the colour picture: for the eye, not a measure of light

sidecar.title: The Moon from Galileo, 7 December 1992 (three filters, enhanced color)

history.note: gray of the colour (0.299, 0.587, 0.114): display levels, not light
columns 1 to 1984, rows 1 to 1984 from the top left: one column and one row off each edge, so that the picture is a whole number of 4-pixel blocks
row 1 is the bottom, as in FITS

citations.text: Galileo image of the Moon, 7 December 1992, PIA00405, NASA/JPL/USGS

steps: Decode the JPEG (image-decode.py, Pillow 11.2.1 (libjpeg 6.2)); gray; crop; block mean; rows from the bottom; base64 in the sidecar. Each step is in image.sidecar.history.

assumptions: The caption’s date is the only time given; none is stated.
No pixel scale is stated or assumed: a lesson uses the Moon’s known diameter.

validation.check: the frame holds one disc of about the expected size, centred: the pixels at 30 or above fill a disc whose equivalent radius is within the stated fraction of the width, with its centre within 2 percent of the middle

against.quantity: equivalent disc radius over the width
against.ref: the lunar disc nearly fills the picture; its limb is close to the edges
